suggestions: navigateTab re-queries the DOM via parentElement.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]') instead of using a ref array; harmless today since the tablist only contains the three tab buttons, but if a nested element ever gets role="tab" inside panel-tabs, index-based focus targeting could silently pick the wrong node. A refs array would be more robust.

The native Tab-exit assertion depends on NodeSpecEditor's internal field order (that 'Cíl práce' is its first focusable field), which is outside this diff. Worth a one-line comment noting that dependency so a future NodeSpecEditor change doesn't silently break this test for unrelated reasons.
structured_output.summary: Reviewed only the P1-keyboard-tabs delta (NodePanel.tsx roving-tabindex handler + new inspector-keyboard.spec.ts). Arrow key wrapping (Right/Left with modulo), Home/End, roving tabIndex (0 for selected tab, -1 otherwise), aria-selected sync, and native Tab exit into the visible panel's first field all check out and match the ARIA APG tablist pattern. Draft preservation (purpose textarea state) works because tab sections stay mounted with `hidden`, unaffected by this change. No security concerns (pure client-side keyboard UI, no untrusted data). No concrete logic errors found; two minor robustness suggestions only. Reported test results (targeted GREEN, 5 repeated runs, full suite 52 passed/1 skipped) are consistent with the code shown. No production-readiness claim implied by this pass.
